args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: Pellow Home Living label confusion (PHL / Covey & Lark)
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion for the Pellow Home Living account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL, and the name field needs to show Pellow Home Living.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on "PHL" returns both accounts. Please use the full account name in subject lines and dropdowns.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living.
- Older Covey & Lark headers still appear in some exports, including an older version of the "Inbound arrivals by hour" export.

Thanks,
Sofia
